Event: the player page lists him as 2000 California State Champion; GenCon (4-0) and the Phoenix MegaSlam (3rd, 2-2) are also named. Editor's notes of 3/29/01 and 3/31/01 add commentary only (no list changes).

Kept general: this 'V2.0' list was posted in March 2001, months after the 2000 California State Championship he says he won with the deck, so it may differ from the list he played there (player_note).
player_note: The post says: 'I've played with this deck off and on since I won the state championships with it in 2000.' and 'I won states with it, went 4-0 at GenCon with it, and went 2-2 at the Phoenix MegaSlam in which I took 3rd ... Overall the deck has a cumulative record of about 27-3.' This 'V2.0' list (posted 4 March 2001) is the deck as rebuilt since, so it may differ from what was played at those events.
